message.content: {"caption":"A three-column process diagram compares two skill-revision methods that use external feedback with SelfEvoSkill, which revises skills by comparing paired executions.","description":"The diagram has three vertical panels. On the left, the gold dashed “Outcome-Gated Evolution” panel shows a document labeled “[Skill S]” leading downward to a robot labeled “[Agent executes],” then to an exclamation icon and “[External outcome signal].” An “external signal” tag sits beside that step. Downward arrows continue to a gavel icon and “[Retain or reject by outcome],” then to a document-and-loop icon labeled “[Skill Iterator].” A curved arrow along the panel’s left side points back upward and is labeled “iterate.” The footer says “requires external outcome signals.” In the center, the gold dashed “Deployment-Feedback Evolution” panel shows “[Skill S]” leading to a robot marked with a red exclamation badge and “[Agent executes],” then down to a diamond labeled “Fail?” The “No” branch points right to “[No evolution].” The “Yes” branch points down to an exclamation icon and “[Deployment feedback],” with an “external signal” tag beside it; arrows then lead to a gavel-like icon and “[Revision signal from feedback],” and to “[Skill Iterator].” A curved “iterate” arrow runs upward along the panel’s left side. Its footer says “requires deployment feedback.” On the right, the blue “SelfEvoSkill (Ours)” panel begins with “[Initial Skill S₀ → evolved skill S*].” A downward arrow leads into the “explore” stage, which contains two side-by-side execution boxes: a robot and trace/document icon labeled “τ_w” and “with skill S,” and a robot and trace/document icon labeled “τ_wo” and “without skill.” A downward connector leads from the paired executions to a document-and-magnifier icon labeled “[PACE] diagnoses paired execution differences”; a green “GT-FREE” badge is beside this step. Arrows continue down to a scales icon and “[Task-Compiled Verifier] checks explicit task constraints,” then to a document-and-loop icon labeled “[Skill Iterator],” with buttons “[Refine]” and “[Repair].” A curved arrow labeled “iterate” runs up the panel’s left side back toward the initial/evolved skill stage. The footer says “no external outcome signals.” No checkmarks or crosses are shown; exclamation badges mark the outcome or feedback steps, and the robot icons denote agent executions.","figure_type":"diagram","chart_values":[]}
